data.name: Sabu
data.gender_notes: Sabu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sabu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sabha' which means 'assembly' or 'council'. It is also the name of the mythological sage Sabari, who is known for her devotion and wisdom. Sabu is a powerful name that signifies strength, leadership, and joy. The name Sabu carries the meaning “Ruler, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Malayalam, Tamil. Parents who choose Sabu usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Sabu is a name with a rich cultural legacy in India. It has been used in various literary works and folklore tales for centuries. One such tale is that of the sage Sabari from the epic Mahabharata, who provided Mahadeva (Lord Shiva) with food and companionship during his exile in the forest. This name holds significant value in the Hindu tradition and is considered an auspicious name for both boys and girls.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sabu holds immense spiritual significance as it is associated with the divine sage Sabari, who is known for her devotion to Lord Shiva. Sabu represents purity, wisdom, and selfless service. It is believed that those bearing this name are endowed with strong character, inner strength, and a deep sense of devotion towards their faith and beliefs. Moreover, the name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of selfless service, leadership, and council to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Sabu in Hindu tradition symbolizes purity and devotion. Sabu means 'one who has the purity of a lion.' It is a name of respect and admiration, evoking images of strength, courage, and inner radiance.

historical_references.reference: Sabu, a famous actor in the Indian film industry, was born on 23 January 1924 in Kerala, India. He got his screen name from the Malayalam word 'Sabhayathu' which means 'wise' or 'intelligent'. Sabu started his film career in 1936 and acted in over 250 films before his retirement in 1978.

Another Sabu is mentioned in the Hindu epic Ramayana. Sabu, the name of a monkey king, played a significant role in the war between Lord Rama and Ravana. He was a powerful and wise monkey leader who was loyal to Lord Rama and helped him in his quest to rescue Sita from Ravana.
